PANELDEV ROUND 1 DONE. Commit e4ddb2c (NOT pushed, chief-law, lead push it).

FILES HIT: cave/panel.mjs, cave/PANEL.md, cave/CIV.md.

SHIP LIST:
- GUARD chip in meta row: "guard on" (muted, boring=good) / "guard off" (AMBER, watch — normal while driver actively drives per issue #6). pollBot() ~line 240-275 maps status.idleGuard.

- DOT go 3-STATE: green=bot connected, AMBER=runner alive but bot not spawned (was hiding under grey "off" before, now own color), grey=runner dead. renderPage() dot logic ~line 1030, chips ~line 1080-1103.

(2) phase-2 event feed — per-card expandable log, data already in /api/fleet, just not rendered. Will pick one next round unless you steer me elsewhere.
